# Better Original (更好的原版) - 整合包介绍

👋 欢迎使用 Better Original —— 一款只为“让原版更舒服，不破坏原版味”而生的轻量整合包。

我深知很多人热爱 Minecraft 原版的纯粹玩法：探索的惊喜、生存的挑战、建造的自由，但也常常被原版的一些小痛点困扰。因此，这款整合包*没有添加任何新物品、新方块、新机制*，不改变原版的核心流程和平衡，所有优化都围绕“修复体验短板、提升流畅度、优化细节质感”展开，让你在原汁原味的 Minecraft 里，获得更丝滑、更省心的游戏体验。

## 🔧 核心优化内容（全程不触碰原版玩法）

- **性能优化**：整合轻量性能模组，修复原版卡顿、掉帧、内存占用过高的问题，低配电脑也能稳定流畅运行，加载速度显著提升，告别长时间加载和莫名闪退。

- **视觉优化**：保留原版纹理和画风，仅添加轻微的视觉增强（如更清晰的字体、更舒适的粒子效果、优化的光影表现，可自由开关），不改变原版的视觉辨识度，却能提升整体观感。

- **兼容性优化**：模组均选用稳定、更新及时的版本，严格适配对应游戏版本，无冲突、无冗余模组，可直接联机（联机时只需所有玩家安装同款整合包即可）。

## 🎯 整合包定位

不是“魔改原版”，而是“打磨原版”。适合所有热爱原版玩法、但希望解决原版小痛点的玩家——无论是新手入门，还是老玩家回归，都能快速适应，因为你玩的依然是你熟悉的那款 Minecraft，只是变得更舒服了。

拒绝冗余模组，拒绝过度优化，一切以“不破坏原版体验”为前提，让每一份探索的快乐、每一次建造的成就感，都和原版完全一致，却少了不必要的麻烦。

## 📋 适配信息

- 游戏版本：1.18.2

- 模组数量：轻量整合（约30-40个核心优化模组，无冗余）

- 适配设备：支持低配电脑（推荐4G内存以上，可根据自身设备调整设置）

- 联机支持：完全支持联机，无联机壁垒

- 更新计划：将随游戏版本更新同步优化模组，及时修复整合包内可能出现的小问题，持续打磨体验。

## 💡 作者寄语

作为一名热爱原版的玩家，我制作这款整合包的初衷，就是想分享“更完美的原版体验”——不添加花里胡哨的内容，不改变原版的核心魅力。

如果在游玩过程中遇到卡顿、冲突等问题，欢迎留言反馈(Email：NUBIStusio@163.com)；如果你有更好的优化建议（前提是不破坏原版玩法），也可以告诉我，一起打磨出更舒服的原版整合包。

最后，希望你能在 Better Original 里，找回原版 Minecraft 的纯粹快乐，享受每一次挖矿、探索、建造的时光 ✨

## ⚠️ 注意事项

- 整合包仅做优化，无任何作弊、破坏平衡的模组，放心游玩。

- 首次加载可能需要1-2分钟（视设备性能而定），属于正常现象。

- 若需添加其他模组，请优先选择与原版兼容的轻量模组，避免与整合包内优化模组冲突。

感谢你的下载与支持，祝游玩愉快！🚀

# Better Original - Modpack Introduction
👋 Welcome to Better Original —— a lightweight modpack designed solely to **"improve the vanilla experience without altering its core essence"**.

I know many of you love the pure gameplay of Minecraft: the thrill of exploration, the challenge of survival, and the freedom of building. Yet, we often struggle with minor annoyances in the vanilla version. That's why this modpack adds **no new items, blocks, or mechanics** — it doesn't change the core progression or balance of the game. All optimizations focus on **fixing pain points, boosting smoothness, and refining details**, letting you enjoy a smoother, more hassle-free experience in the authentic Minecraft world.

## 🔧 Core Optimizations (No Changes to Vanilla Gameplay)
- **Performance Optimization**: Integrates lightweight performance mods to resolve lag, frame drops, and excessive memory usage. Runs stably and smoothly even on low-end PCs, with significantly faster load times — goodbye to long waits and random crashes.
- **Visual Optimization**: Preserves vanilla textures and art style, adding only subtle visual enhancements (such as sharper fonts, smoother particle effects, and optimized lighting — all toggleable). It maintains the game's iconic visual identity while elevating overall aesthetics.
- **Compatibility Optimization**: All mods are selected for stability and timely updates, fully compatible with the target game version. No conflicts or redundant mods, and direct multiplayer support is available — all players just need to install the same modpack for co-op.

## 🎯 Modpack Positioning
This is not a "vanilla overhall" — it's a **polished vanilla experience**. It's perfect for all players who love vanilla gameplay but want to fix minor annoyances: whether you're a beginner just starting out or a veteran returning to the game, you'll adapt instantly. You're still playing the Minecraft you know and love, just a more comfortable version.

We reject redundant mods and excessive optimization — all changes prioritize "preserving the vanilla experience". Every joy of exploration and sense of achievement from building remains authentic, with unnecessary hassles eliminated.

## 📋 Compatibility Info
- **Game Version**: 1.18.2
- **Number of Mods**: Lightweight integration (around 30-40 core optimization mods, no bloat)
- **Device Support**: Compatible with low-end PCs (4GB+ RAM recommended; adjust settings based on your device)
- **Multiplayer Support**: Fully supported, no multiplayer barriers
- **Update Plan**: Will synchronize mod optimizations with game version updates, timely fix minor issues in the modpack, and continuously refine the experience.

## 💡 Author's Note
As a vanilla enthusiast, my goal in creating this modpack is to share a **"more perfect vanilla experience"** — no flashy additions, no changes to the game's core charm.

If you encounter lag, conflicts, or other issues during gameplay, please leave feedback (Email: NUBIStusio@163.com). If you have better optimization suggestions (as long as they don't break vanilla gameplay), feel free to reach out — let's polish this better vanilla modpack together.

Finally, I hope you can rediscover the pure joy of Minecraft in Better Original, and enjoy every moment of mining, exploring, and building ✨

## ⚠️ Notes
- This modpack only includes optimizations — no cheats or balance-breaking mods, so play with confidence.
- The first load may take 1-2 minutes (depending on your device performance) — this is normal.
- If you want to add other mods, prioritize lightweight mods compatible with vanilla to avoid conflicts with the optimization mods in this pack.

Thank you for your download and support! Have a great time playing! 🚀
